📄 Read codes & quantities from a PDF or photo
The file stays on this device. Every line is checked against your catalogue and against the document itself before it is added.
Best results
• A PDF made by software (Jaquar / dealer quotation) is read exactly — nothing is guessed.
• For a photo: flat, straight, sharp, the whole table in the frame, no shadow across the codes.
• Codes of the usual shape (ALD-CHR-079N) are picked up; the few catalogue items without that shape must be typed.
